See the GitHub release for v1.0.1.
Expand compatibility and auditing across six agent hosts; add safer visibility controls, presets, recovery guidance, and version reporting.
Fix Codex skill discovery to ignore stale plugin-cache entries.

- Expanded description and documentation to clarify additional use cases and supported platforms.
- Documented new Claude Code visibility states (`on`, `name-only`, `user-invocable-only`, `off`) and introduced the `set` command for fine-grained visibility control.
- Added guidance on skill selectors, highlighting key differences between display names and config keys, and how to use group and path selectors.
- Improved documentation on group-based skill management, including taxonomy support with pattern matching.
- Clarified safety guarantees and updated platform-specific behavior notes.
- Removed the sample file skill-card.md.

- Removed the sample skill-card.md file.
- SKILL.md: Shortened the description for clarity and conciseness; functionality and safety notes unchanged.
- No code or command changes. Only documentation and file cleanup.

- Added flexible JSON output: place --json before or after any command.
- Documented structured output for automation.
- Added parser coverage for both JSON flag positions.

- Added platform-agnostic usage and command examples for Windows, macOS, and Linux in the documentation.
- Clarified path selector behavior and instructions for quoting absolute paths with spaces.
- Removed the redundant sample skill-card.md file.
- Added a compiled Python cache file in scripts/__pycache__ for the skill management script.

Initial release of manage-agent-skills.

- Add on-demand, deterministic management script (`skillctl.py`) for auditing, searching, enabling, disabling, and applying presets to Agent Skills across multiple platforms.
- Enforce explicit, platform-specific commands to avoid accidental changes; supports Codex, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot CLI, OpenClaw, and Hermes Agent.
- Never runs as a daemon; discovers current skills on every invocation.
- Adopts a safety-first approach: backs up config files, never deletes SKILL.md files, and restricts disable-all unless explicitly forced.
- Offers dry-run preview mode, scope-based disabling for Hermes, and preset application via JSON following documented references.
- Includes platform-specific handling and explains when agent sessions or restarts are needed for changes to take effect.
